name: Tammie Ash Salon Amaranth
description: Tammie Ash Salon Amaranth is a calm, light-filled salon for beautiful blondes, lived-in foils, precision cuts, and the perfect blow-dry. Good hair happens here.

hero.title: Good hair happens here.
hero.subtitle: Beautiful blondes, foils, cuts, and blow-dries in a calm, welcoming space. Call to secure your appointment.

stylists.name: Tammie Ash
stylists.title: Owner
stylists.bio: Founder of Salon Amaranth, Tammie built a space where hair, beauty, and wellbeing come together — because beautiful hair makes happier people.

stylists.name: Emerson
stylists.title: Stylist
stylists.bio: Emerson loves soft, lived-in blondes, full foils, and finishing every look with a flawless cut and blow-dry.

reviews.name: Sophie M.
reviews.text: My foils have never looked so soft and natural. The salon is gorgeous and I left feeling completely refreshed.

reviews.name: Kate H.
reviews.text: Emerson is amazing — my blonde is exactly what I wanted and the blow-dry lasted for days.

reviews.name: Rachel P.
reviews.text: Such a calm, beautiful space. You really feel looked after from the moment you walk in.

reviews.name: Emma L.
reviews.text: Best cut and colour I've had in years. Good hair really does happen here!
